title: What counts as use?
source: U.S. Census Bureau Business Trends and Outlook Survey
questionParaphrase: Whether the business used SI, formerly AI, in any business function during the reference interval.
unit: In-scope employer business; weighted business responses, not workers, tasks or hours.
denominator: Sum of nonresponse-adjusted weights of businesses answering this question, including Do not know.

primarySources.location: URR - National and Response Count - National A1:A2; dates D83:I83

limits: Sampling SE does not cover systematic bias.
No intensity, hours saved, workflow completion, productivity, jobs or ASI capability estimated.
No old/new series splice or causal wording adjustment.
A dated core estimate, not pooled supplement or future2027questionnaire.

Overall survey response count and unit rate are rounded for disclosure protection. AI-question item-response coverage remains unverified; do not multiply the weighted adoption estimate by the overall respondent count.
artwork: Original deterministic layout by Anti Hunter / AI/MAXXI; no third-party chart or logo reproduced.

responseCoverage.respondentDefinition: A business answering at least one survey question.
responseCoverage.scope: Overall biweekly survey unit response; not the number answering the AI-use item or the weighted denominator of its response estimates. No exact R, NR or eligible population reconstructed.
